messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick sync on ClarityQ case study — interview raw + transcript up in Drive. Need quote sign-off, legal review for benchmark wording, and webinar coordination. Target publish: Wed 09/09 09:00 PT (customer embargo).
Tess Morgan: I'll own the customer sign-off. Can someone confirm the hero quote draft? Also who is doing the landing page copy?
Benita Cruz: Creative can do hero + 4 social sizes + 2 clips (15s/45s) and a gated one-pager. Need final quote + hero image from the customer.
Noah Rivera: Draft hero quote from the call: "Redwood reduced our inference latency and let us bring relevance improvements to production faster." Sending to ClarityQ for approval now.
Sam Wu: Ops note: I'll set HubSpot form routing to tag leads as "clarityq-case-2026" and route to AE + CS. Recommend gating the one-pager to increase MQL quality.
LegalBot: Legal review requested. Please attach benchmark methodology document. Benchmarks must be phrased as "approximately X%" or "approximately Xx" and cite test ID. Redact any PII in transcript before publishing.
Tess Morgan: Customer replied — approve with tweaks. They want wording: "Redwood reduced our median latency by ~2.2x during our production workload, helping us ship a relevance feature sooner." They signed the release and uploaded it to the shared drive.
Benita Cruz: Noted. We'll avoid absolute language in visuals. Need the exact numbers from eng for the methodology blurb. Also confirm preferred hero image (they provided a product screenshot).
Noah Rivera: Engineering reports ~2.2x median latency improvement at 1.5k token runs and ~28% lower cost per token on their workload. Marketing phrasing: "approximately 2.2x median latency improvement" and "approximately 28% lower cost per token". Cite test ID CQ-2026-42.
LegalBot: Verified release received: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/clarityq/RELEASE_3971234899.pdf. Legal approves publication with the phrasing Noah suggested and recommends removing any competitor comparisons. Redactions completed.
Sam Wu: HubSpot routing configured and UTMs set. I'll also wire a small nurture flow for inbound leads from the case study.
Tess Morgan: Customer preview request: I'll post the landing draft link once I finish copy edits. Also confirm webinar: ClarityQ agreed to a 12-minute slot on 2026-09-16 for a joint demo. Can comms team schedule?
Benita Cruz: ETA for assets: final exports (hero image, social cards, 15s & 45s clips, one-pager) by Fri 09/04 EOD if copy + legal done. I'll include caption files and accessible transcripts for clips.
Noah Rivera: Embargo set for Wed 09/09 09:00 PT. Customer preview scheduled Mon 09/07. Please do not publish before embargo.
Sam Wu: Webinar invite created and calendar hold sent to speakers. HubSpot form will include a checkbox for webinar interest so we can route those leads to SDR for follow-up.
Tess Morgan: Posted landing draft for customer preview: https://redwood.in/internal-drafts/clarityq-case-2026. Waiting on customer sign-off and will update this thread when they approve.
LegalBot: All legal checks complete. Release stored at https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/clarityq/RELEASE_3971234899.pdf. Publish allowed after embargo and final customer preview.
Noah Rivera: Thanks team. Final checklist: customer-approved quote (done), signed release (done), legal ok (done), creative exports (Benita), HubSpot routing (Sam). We'll reconvene here for final go/no-go before 09/09 publish. :rocket:
